population_rules.rule: Apply age category from primary_dragon_attributes and secondary_dragon_attributes after choosing habitat variant.
If two dragons are encountered, they are a mated pair if adult or older, or siblings if juvenile or younger.
If three or more dragons are encountered, they are a mated pair if adult or older along with offspring that are juvenile or younger.
Roll treasure separately for each dragon based on age.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Unless prevented, dragons tend to use breath weapon as their initial attack in combat.
On later rounds, dragons use breath weapon about 50% of the time.
Dragons may bargain or surrender to preserve their lives or gain advantage.

attack_routine.name: melee_routine
attack_routine.usage: when breath weapon is not used

attack_routine.name: breath_weapon_routine
attack_routine.usage: initial attack if possible; about 50% of subsequent rounds

attack_effect.damage: 1d6 per Hit Die of the dragon.
attack_effect.effect: Area and secondary effect depend on habitat variant.

immunities.immunity: Immune to its own breath weapon.
Immune to the same kind of breath weapon from other dragons.
Immune to ordinary instances of energy or substance similar to its breath weapon.

resistances.resistance: Takes half damage from magical attacks similar to the nature of its breath weapon.

mobility_rules.rule: Standard dragons use land and flight movement from the stat block unless modified by variant rules.

targeting_constraints.constraint: General breath-shape rule: cloud-shaped effects occupy 20' high, 40' long, and 40' wide.
General breath-shape rule: cone-shaped effects begin at 2' width and spread to 90' long and 30' wide.
General breath-shape rule: line-shaped effects are 100' long and 5' wide.
Use the printed habitat breath profile for each variant.

ability.name: breath_weapon_acid
ability.effect: The acid stream burns through wooden or metal barriers and continues to full length.
The acid corrodes metal, wood, and cloth it touches.

ability.name: breath_weapon_fetid_gas
ability.effect: Afflicted creatures lose 1d4 STR, 1d4 DEX, and 1d4 CON each day until cured.
If any affected ability score is reduced to 0, the creature dies.
ability.termination: Cured by cure disease cast by a 9th level or higher cleric.
ability.notes: Lost ability score points recover at 1 point per day after the disease is cured.

ability.name: breath_weapon_obscuring_vapors
ability.effect: Blistering steam, freezing vapors, poison vapor, and scouring wind partly obscure the affected area for 1 round after the dragon breathes.
Attacks into or through the area suffer -2 to attack throws.

ability.name: breath_weapon_lightning_bolt
ability.effect: May melt lead, gold, copper, silver, or bronze.
If damage to an interposing barrier breaks through it, the bolt may continue beyond the barrier.

ability.name: breath_weapon_fire
ability.effect: Ignites combustibles and damages objects in the area.
May melt lead, gold, copper, silver, or bronze.
If damage to an interposing barrier breaks through it, the breath may continue beyond the barrier to attain full volume.

ability.name: clutching_claws
ability.trigger: Used as a dive attack with claws.
ability.effect: Deals double damage.
If both claw attacks hit a creature smaller than the dragon, the dragon automatically grabs the creature.
ability.notes: Grabbed humanoids, and any creatures with less than half the dragon's Hit Dice, can be carried off.

ability.name: decapitating_bite
ability.trigger: Natural attack throw of 19-20 with bite.

save.on_success: target survives but takes quadruple bite damage

ability.name: elemental_aura
ability.effect: Creatures within 5' of the dragon take 1d4 damage per round from an aura matching the dragon's breath weapon.

ability.name: fear_aura
ability.trigger: When the dragon charges or flies overhead.
ability.effect: Creatures with less than 1 Hit Die flee in panic for 4d6 turns.
Creatures with 1-3 Hit Dice that fail are paralyzed with fear.
Creatures with more than 3 Hit Dice that fail suffer -1 to attack throws.
ability.duration: The fear effect lasts until the dragon is slain or passes out of sight and sound.

ability.name: gem_encrusted_hide
ability.effect: Gain +2 bonus to AC.
Movement is reduced by 30'.
ability.notes: The AC bonus becomes +3 at Very Old and +4 at Venerable.

ability.name: horrific_stench
ability.effect: Nauseated creatures suffer -3 to attack throws and damage rolls.
ability.duration: 1d4+4 rounds after leaving the dragon's vicinity.

ability.name: invulnerable
ability.effect: Cannot be harmed by non-magical weapons.

ability.name: massive_size
ability.effect: Hit Dice increase by 3.
Claw damage, bite damage, and breath weapon damage increase commensurately.
ability.notes: Venerable dragons attack for 3d6/3d6/6d8 if taken once and 3d8/3d8/6d10 if taken twice.

ability.name: paralyzing_blows
ability.effect: Claw and bite attacks channel negative energy and cause paralysis for 3d4 turns.
ability.exception: Only chaotic dragons may have this special ability.
ability.notes: Otherwise identical to a ghoul's paralysis.

ability.name: poisonous_blood
ability.trigger: Any opponent that successfully hits the dragon in melee.

ability.name: polymorph_self
ability.effect: May change shape at will to any humanoid or animal form.
ability.exception: Only dragons capable of casting spells may have this special ability.

ability.name: tail_lash
ability.effect: May make one additional melee attack each round against targets to the rear.
Tail damage equals the dragon's bite damage.

ability.name: wing_claws
ability.effect: May make two additional melee attacks each round with wing claws.
Wing-claw damage equals the dragon's claw damage for its age category.

habitat.rule: Habitat determines common dragon variant, hide colors, and breath weapon profile.

social_structure.rule: Encounter composition depends on age and number encountered.

communication.rule: Dragons that can speak know Common, Draconic, and one other language.

behavior_rules.rule: Neutral dragons may or may not converse depending on circumstances.
Lawful dragons are more likely to aid a good party or a party on a noble mission.
Chaotic dragons are likely to attack on sight unless restraint offers gain.

treasure_rules.rule: Captured live dragons may be sold in a Class I or II market for 1,000 gp per total hit point.
An enslaved dragon becomes a henchman of the enslaving character but always desires freedom.
An enslaved dragon makes a Henchman Loyalty roll whenever it has an opportunity to escape or betray its master.
Apply the dragon's normal morale bonus as a penalty to that loyalty roll.

treasure_and_rewards.xp_rule: A dragon capable of speech counts as having one additional special ability for XP purposes, except Ancient and Venerable dragons where this is already factored into XP.

procedure.name: derive_dragon_statistics
procedure.condition: Use when building a specific dragon from this entry.

steps.step: Choose age category from primary_dragon_attributes and secondary_dragon_attributes.
Apply percent_in_lair, armor_class, hit_dice, damage, save, morale, treasure_type, and xp from primary_dragon_attributes.
Apply dungeon_encounter, wilderness_encounter, chance_asleep, chance_speech, special_ability_count, and spells_per_day from secondary_dragon_attributes.
Assign special abilities appropriate to habitat and alignment based on special_ability_count, or create custom abilities if desired.
If the dragon can speak, it can cast the listed number of arcane spells per day and knows the same number of arcane spells.
Apply any variant-specific rules such as sea_dragon_mobility_modification.

procedure.outcome: A fully derived dragon variant with habitat-specific breath weapon and age-based statistics.

procedure.name: sleeping_dragons
procedure.condition: Dragon is encountered in its lair or otherwise on the ground.

steps.step: Roll against the age category's chance_asleep from secondary_dragon_attributes.
If asleep, opponents may attack for one round with +2 to attack throws.
Thieves may backstab a sleeping dragon.
After that round, the dragon awakens whether or not any attack hit.

procedure.outcome: Combat proceeds normally from round 2 onward.

steps.step: Characters may attempt to incapacitate and capture a dragon using incapacitating attacks or other methods.
If captured, the dragon may be enslaved or sold.
If enslaved, treat it as a henchman of the enslaving character.
Whenever escape or betrayal is possible, roll Henchman Loyalty with the dragon's morale bonus applied as a penalty.
If sold alive, price is 1,000 gp per total hit point in a Class I or II market.
